sources.snippet: On Mixpeek, wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-japanese runs as a managed extractor inside a processing pipeline. Point a bucket of automatic speech recognition data at it, and Mixpeek handles GPU provisioning, batching, retries, and writing the outputs into a vector store you can query.
